يمتنعان (form VIII)
# يَمْتَنِعَانِ (yamtaniʕāni) /jam.ta.ni.ʕaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# يُمْتَنَعَانِ (yumtanaʕāni) /jum.ta.na.ʕaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
